title: Theme-coloured logo balanced with the compact masthead
user_quote: Should we update logo based on current color scheme and also should we match the size of the icon with master head text, icon is smaller than the text
scope: Interpret the ongoing design request as a local refinement of colour and relative icon size. Keep the established logo geometry and compact header; no new identity or public deployment.

implementation.symbol: Original three paths unchanged; new versioned SVG uses a single Ink & Voice accent. The shared header inlines its paths with currentColor.
implementation.sizing: 1.2em icon square relative to unchanged 34/30/28px Newsreader masthead text; optical compensation for original SVG whitespace.
implementation.favicon: Matching versioned SVG; standalone prefers-color-scheme follows system appearance, independently of the in-site manual theme toggle.
implementation.preserved: Original teal/rust symbol and all three path geometries, compact navigation/spacing, cover designs, poetry, runtime settings and sharing rules.

checklist.page_family: Shared website masthead, applied to all assembled reader page families; favicon.
checklist.purpose: Recognizable home link with balanced symbol and English name.
checklist.artwork: Versioned recolour of existing SVG paths; no generated artwork or historical overwrite.
checklist.accessibility: Decorative inline SVG aria-hidden and nonfocusable; existing Kabita Live home name retained. 48px menu target retained.
checklist.browser: Inspected home at 1280/1000/760/390/320px, phone light/dark and edition header; menu opens, Escape closes and focus returns; home-link navigation verified.
checklist.content: Edition/source check passed; 607 protected files unchanged; cover/share mappings unchanged by this scope.

tests.note: Initial tests started before the build finished and encountered missing dist files; that log is retained. Final full suite rerun after build completion passed.

verification.reviewer: Current chat assistant; Samanta implementation / Drishti self-review
limits: One Chromium desktop engine with responsive viewports; no fresh 200-percent browser text-enlargement, screen-reader speech or native-phone test.
Favicon file and export verified; actual OS/browser chrome icon cache not inspected.
No public deployment. Earlier artistic-audit findings about separator colours and editorial type remain open; this request changed the logo only.

next_action: Review the updated stable local preview. Publication remains separate.
